title: Recording: Mrs Vandebilt by Wings | 1973
content:
EMI Studios, Lagos
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

The sixth recording session for Wings’ third album, Band On The Run, took place on 10 September 1973.

The sessions were held at EMI Studios at 7 Wharf Road in Apapa, Lagos.

The precise recording dates are not known, but it is likely that on this day they began work on the song ‘Mrs Vandebilt’, which initially had the working title ‘Mrs Vanderbilt’.

The backing track had Paul McCartney on drums, Denny Laine on acoustic guitar, and Linda McCartney on electric piano.

Overdubs included bass guitar, double-tracked lead vocals, lead guitar, and a second acoustic guitar part.
